news.title: PayPal Sets Settlement and Dispute Rules for Agentic Virtual Cards
news.body: PayPal’s newly effective merchant terms govern settlement, fees, refunds and disputes for virtual cards used in agentic commerce. For merchants, these contractual rules determine acceptance costs and how payment teams handle refunds and chargebacks—not simply whether an AI agent can complete checkout.

news.title: Payoneer Receives Conditional Approval for Trust Bank
news.body: Payoneer received conditional approval for a trust bank, but the decision does not authorize an operational launch. Proposed bank CEO Rob Morgan discussed issuance, reserves and the opening examination with Banking Dive. The examination and final authorization remain milestones before prospective partners can treat the proposed banking services as available.

news.title: Klarna Expands Distribution Through Visa Acceptance Platform
news.body: Klarna’s expanded Visa partnership broadens access to its offering for Visa Acceptance Platform merchants, according to the companies’ announcement. The agreement adds a distribution channel; it does not establish how many merchants have activated Klarna or what conversion results they have achieved. Country eligibility and pricing will determine the option’s availability and cost for individual merchants.

news.title: Adyen Moves to Sole-CEO Leadership as Van der Does Retires
news.body: Pieter van der Does is retiring as Adyen’s co-CEO, leaving Ingo Uytdehaage as sole chief executive, Finextra reports. The transition consolidates executive leadership rather than bringing in an outside successor. The announcement alone does not establish a change to Adyen’s strategy or financial guidance.

news.title: Canada Selects FDX for Open-Banking Technical Standards
news.body: Canada selected Financial Data Exchange as the technical standards body for open banking. Banks and fintechs now have a designated organization around which to coordinate connectivity work, although the selection does not itself establish production access. Canadian technical specifications, certification requirements and implementation dates will define the scope of integration work.

perspective: PayPal’s agentic-card terms and Payoneer’s conditional trust bank approval accompany changes in merchant distribution, payments leadership and Canadian open-banking standards.

curiosity.text: Nacha formed in 1974 to administer the ACH Network—not to introduce electronic check conversion. ACH stands for Automated Clearing House, and the network carries both credit entries, such as payroll deposits, and debit entries, such as authorized bill payments. Source: Nacha, “The ACH Network: A Brief History” — https://www.nacha.org/content/ach-network-brief-history
